title: Transparent Glass Avatar
content:
I want to Learn how to turn your Avatar into a transparent glass Avatar and as all of the community members being my Seniors and my Teachers can guide me through the process and I would if any one can share the Avatar file with me


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi and welcome! Turning the avatar to Glass is fast and easy. You can select the Avatar om the 3D window > Go to the Property Editor > Change Material type to Glass.Just keep in mind Glass is render only so you will only see it in the Render EngineFor further support please make sure to post your from your account that has a valid CLO license 🙂
Reply 1: ❤️ I Will keep it in mind
content_description: This web page serves as a collaborative space for learning how to create a transparent glass Avatar, where experienced community members can guide newcomers and share necessary Avatar files.
